title: Verb 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: Mu gacanyi kuri ikinyarwanda, twe dufite ibinyabwenge bibiri: 'kuwa' na 'kuba'. Mu Icyongereza harimo rimwe rumwe: 'to be'. Ikimenyetso nke niyo yuko mu ikinyarwanda ntitwaronka ibinyabwenge byo kugena umuntu no kuba mu mutwe, nk’uko bikorwa mu Icyongereza. Ikibanjirije ni uko mu Icyongereza NTIBITONZE umuntu: kandi wigeze ushaka ‘I am’, ‘you are’, ‘he is’, cyangwa undi wundi.
rule: Ibinyabwenge by’icyongereza ‘to be’ mu gihe k’uno birimo itatu: ‘am’ (ku wa ‘I’), ‘is’ (ku wa ‘he, she, it’) na ‘are’ (ku wa ‘you, we, they’). Kugira ngo usabe, ubika impinduka mu mubare: ‘Are you...?’, ‘Is he...?’. Kugira ngo ukeneye, onyonga ‘not’: ‘I am not’, ‘he is not’ (cyangwa ‘he isn’t’), ‘they are not’ (cyangwa ‘they aren’t’).

concept_examples.translation: Yaremye ari umwe mu bafite ubufaranga.
Ese wifite agahinda? (mu cyongereza: Are you hungry?)

common_error.explanation: Mu ikinyarwanda tugamba ‘Ndahemukiye’ ntidufite ibinyabwenge by’ubutaro, ariko mu Icyongereza ibinyabwenge bya ‘to be’ birimo byose. Ntukabye ‘am/is/are’.

examples.note: Tukoresha ‘is’ ku wa umuntu w’umwe mu gihe k’uno.
Tukura impinduka mu mubare kugira ngo tusabe.

title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
bridge: Mu gihugu cy'Espanya, amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu ari nk'iyi: yo, wowe, yishe, yise, twe, mwe, bo. Ikibanjiranye kuri buhoro ni uko mu gihugu cy'Angilize, dusaba gusaba amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu nk'umuntu, naho mu gihugu cy'Espanya tubyara: 'I am tired' (ntibyo yita 'am tired'). Nanone, kugira ubwoba kuri gutangira 'he' na 'she' — mu gihugu cy'Angilize, biratuma ku mubiri, si ku mubiri w'ijambo nk'aho ari mu gihugu cy'Espanya.
rule: Amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu mu gihugu cy'Angilize ari: I (yo), you (wowe/wowe/mwe), he (yishe), she (yise), it (byiza), we (twe), they (bo). 'It' bushyigikiwe kuri ibintu, inyama na ibirimo. 'You' birashobora kuba mu singuli cyangwa mu byatanu. Ntibishobora kugira umuntu wo mu gihugu cy'Angilize.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: Mu gihugu cy'Espanya, dusaba 'Es profesor' tubyara umuntu, ariko mu gihugu cy'Angilize, amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu ari ngombwa. Ushobora kuba 'He is...' cyangwa 'She is...'.

levels.label: Singular pronouns
levels.translation: Amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu mu singuli

examples.note: Umuntu wo mu mbere mu singuli.

levels.label: Third person singular
levels.translation: Umuntu wo mu mbere mu singuli

levels.label: Plural pronouns
levels.translation: Amajambo yo kwiyumvira abantu mu byatanu

examples.note: 'It' bushyigikiwe kuri ibintu, inyama na ibirimo.

title: Imigambi (a/an, the)
bridge: Mu gaciriyano naho hari imigambi: 'un/una' (ntagaragara) na 'el/la/los/las' (taragara). Ububikozi bukomeye ni ukwo mu gaciriyano ntushimisha 'the' kuri ibyo tugendeshwa mu binyacumu (tuvuga 'Life is beautiful', si 'The life is beautiful'). Nanone remera ko mu gaciriyano, kuri imirimo, tushimisha 'a' cyangwa 'an': 'I am a teacher' (mu gaciriyano tuvuga 'Soy profesor' bitagaragara imigambi).
rule: Tushimisha 'a' mbere y’amagambo yatangira ku mwanya w’imvomo (a book, a car). Tushimisha 'an' mbere y’amagambo yatangira ku mwanya w’umwenda (an apple, an hour — 'h' atasanzwe). Tushimisha 'the' kugirango tuve mu kintu gisabwe cyangwa kivugwemo. Ntushimisha 'the' kuri ibyo tugendeshwa mu binyacumu (Love is important, si 'The love').

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciriyano tuvuga 'Soy profesor' bitagaragara imigambi. Mu gaciriyano, kuri imirimo, byose tushimisha 'a' cyangwa 'an'.

examples.note: 'The' tushimisha kuri kintu gisabwe cyangwa gikubiwemo.
Kuri ibyo tugendeshwa mu binyacumu, NTUSHIMISHA 'the'.

title: Ibinyabiziga by’ingenzi n’ibitarengwa by’ibinyabiziga
bridge: Mu gaciri, dusiga ibinyabiziga kugeza -s cyangwa -es (casa → casas, reloj → relojes). Mu Icyongereza ni ibyerekeranye: amajambo menshi yongera -s (book → books), ariko harimo amategeko anyabwa: n’iyo ujambo bukomeye ku -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z, tungeramo -es (bus → buses, watch → watches). Harimo no kwibinyabiziga kitari nka byinshi (child → children, foot → feet) kutakwenda ku mategeko aha ari n’ibintu dusabwa kwibuka.
rule: Ibinyabiziga by’ingenzi: 1) Ongeramo -s (cat → cats). 2) Ongeramo -es n’iyo ujambo bukomeye ku -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z (box → boxes, dish → dishes). 3) N’iyo bukomeye ku -y bishushanyijwe n’umubano, hindura -y kuva -ies (city → cities). 4) N’iyo bukomeye ku -f cyangwa -fe, bakwiye kugerageza kuva -ves (wolf → wolves, knife → knives). Ibinyabiziga kitari nka byinshi ni ibintu: child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep (birenze), fish → fish (birenze ku buryo bubiri).

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, byose ibinyabiziga by’ingenzi (umwana → abana), ariko mu Icyongereza 'child' ni kitari nka byinshi kandi ibinyabiziga bya byo ni 'children'. Ni ububuzima bw’ibinyabiziga bukomeye kuri abanyarwanda kugeza ku mategeko yongera -s.

title: Ibyo biba (Nya, uza, yaba)
bridge: Mu gaciriyano, dutegura ibyo biba kugirango tudebeze ibikorwa bikorwa neza: 'Nyakarya pizza byumba'. Mu Icyongereza ni ko bigaragara, ariko harimo ububabare bwihariye: mu ndimi ya gatatu (he, she, it) dufunga -s ku murongo (he eats, she works). Nanone dukeneye kugara urubanza 'do/does' mu byibazo n'ibyo bishyiramo amakubabaro, nk'uko mu gaciriyano dutegura '¿...?' hamwe no kwivugana, ariko aha ni wajyambere.
rule: Ibyo biba bifungurwa no kwandika inyandiko ya murongo ku buri wese usibye mu ndimi ya gatatu ya muntu (he, she, it), ubwo turongora -s (cyangwa -es nibwo ifuza na -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z). Mu byibazo n'ibyo bishyiramo amakubabaro dutegura 'do' (ku va I, you, we, they) cyangwa 'does' (ku va he, she, it) + inyandiko ya murongo (usibye -s). Keretse: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciriyano, mu ndimi ya gatatu ya muntu nta mwishura wihariye mu byo biba (él come), ariko mu Icyongereza byakomeye kufunga -s (he eats). Uyu ni umwe mu bihe bigaragara kurushwa n'abavuga igaciriyano.

examples.note: Inyandiko ya murongo mu buryo bw'inyandiko.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.

title: Imirimo y'ubwoko (always, sometimes, never)
bridge: Mu igifaransa, imirimo y'ubwoko nk'uko ni 'siempre', 'a veces' na 'nunca' birebana n'ubwoko bw'imvugo: 'Yo siempre como pizza' cyangwa inyuma y'ubwoko mu bihe byinshi. Mu Icyongereza, ubwoko ni ukwiye: kenshi birasanga inyuma y'ubwoko bw'imvugo (I always eat pizza), ariko inyuma y'ubwoko 'to be' (I am always tired). Ububabare bw'ingenzi ni ko mu igifaransa dushobora kubiramo mu mutwe w'imvugo, ariko mu Icyongereza ibyo bitangaje.
rule: Imirimo y'ubwoko y'ingenzi ni: always (siempre), usually (normalmente), often (a menudo), sometimes (a veces), rarely (raramente), never (nunca). Birasanga INYUMANWA y'ubwoko bw'imvugo (I always go to school), ariko INYUMANWA y'ubwoko 'to be' (I am always happy). Mu ibibazo, birasanga inyuma y'ubwoko (Do you always eat breakfast?)

concept_examples.text: I always drink coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz drɪŋk ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: They sometimes go to the cinema.
concept_examples.translation: Baravuga bihagije bashobora kugenda mu kino.

common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa tusubira 'Yo siempre como pizza' cyangwa 'Yo como pizza siempre'. Mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw'imirimo y'ubwoko birasanga INYUMANWA y'ubwoko bw'imvugo (always eat). Kubiramo mu mutwe bitangaje kuba ni ubugeni bw'igifaransa.

examples.original: I always get up at 7 am.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɡet ʌp æt ˈsevən æm/

examples.translation: Nta n'umwe wacu yemeza kurya ibiribwa.

examples.note: Ubwoko bw'imirimo y'ubwoko birasanga INYUMANWA y'ubwoko 'to be'.

title: Have got / Has got
bridge: Mu gacanyi, kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. Mu gacanyi, kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. Mu gacanyi, kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. 'Have got' ni ikoranije kinini mu gacanyi ya Ubuvuzi na kinijwe mu mibare y'amagambo. Ubuvuzi bw'inyandiko ni ubwoko bw'amagambo, kandi 'have got' bwije mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. Mu gacanyi, kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. 'Have got' ni ikoranije kinini mu gacanyi ya Ubuvuzi na kinijwe mu mibare y'amagambo. Ubwoko bw'inyandiko ni ubwoko bw'amagambo, kandi 'have got' bwije mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu.
rule: Have got / Has got bifashwa kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu, ububiko, ibyambo by'ubwoko na ubushakashatsi. Kuva mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Ntibifashwa: I/you/we/they have not got (haven't got), he/she/it has not got (hasn't got). Ibibazo: Have I/you/we/they got? Has he/she/it got? Ntibifashwa 'do/does'. Mu by'amezi: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Bifashwa neza mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu; kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu bifashwa 'have' gusa.

concept_examples.text: I have got a new phone.

common_error.explanation: Mu gacanyi, 'tener' bishinzwe 'have' cyangwa 'have got'. Ariko 'have got' bishinzwe 'got', ntibishinzwe 'get'. Kugena 'I have get' ni ububiko bw'amagambo kuko bishinzwe mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu. Remera: 'have got' ni kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu.

levels.label: Affirmative with I/you/we/they
levels.translation: Kuva mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu n'I/you/we/they

examples.original: We have got a big house.
examples.note: Tufata 'have got' kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu.

levels.label: Affirmative with he/she/it
levels.translation: Kuva mu kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu n'he/she/it

examples.note: Tufata 'has got' kugena ubwoko dufata amaso no kwiga inyandiko zacu kuri wundi mucyeezwa.

title: Ibyo bishushanyije ahantu (in, on, under, next to)
bridge: Mu igifaransa, dutegura uru kandi 'en' kugena mu byinshi: 'en la maison', 'en la table', 'en la rue'. Mu icyongereza, harimo ibyo bishushanyije ahantu menshi kandi ikintu gishushanyijwe kigerageza ku ibyago. 'In' bishushanywa mu ibintu bifuzwemo cyangwa byinshi (in the room), 'on' kuri ibyo bishushanywa kuri ibyo bishushanywa (on the table), 'under' kuri ibyo bishushanywa (under the bed) na 'next to' kuri ibyo bishushanywa (next to the door). Kandi niba wibuka ko 'en la esquina' bishushanywa 'on the corner' (nta 'in').
rule: Ibyo bishushanyije ahantu byabanjirije: in (mu, mu kintu kifuzwemo), on (kuri, kuri urubura), under (hasi ya), next to (hasi ya). Nanone: behind (nyuma), in front of (mbere), between (mu bice). Mu icyongereza cy'Ubuwongereza, kuri uburemere burimo 'on the bus', 'on the train', ariko 'in the car'. Mu ibibazo: 'Where is the cat?' → 'It is under the table.'

concept_examples.text: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The supermarket is next to the bank.
concept_examples.translation: Umusaruro w'ibintu wifashwa hasi ya banki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt ɪz nekst tə ðə bæŋk/

common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa tuganira 'en el autobús' kugena mu byinshi, ariko mu icyongereza, kuri uburemere bw'uburemere bw'ubwoko (bus, train, plane), bishushanywa 'on', si 'in'. 'In' bishushanywa mu imodoka na takisi (in the car).

examples.original: The milk is in the fridge.
The keys are on the table.
My shoes are under the chair.
The school is next to the church.
examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/
examples.note: Dutegura 'next to' kuri ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko.

title: Ibyo bifuzwa (this, that, these, those)
bridge: Mu gaciri, dushimira 'uwo' (akabije), 'uwundi' (umubare w'akagari) na 'uwundi' (akaye). Mu Icyongereza harimo ububiko bw'akagari bibiri gusa: 'this' (ubwokozi) na 'these' (ubwokozi) kuri bya kuri; 'that' (ubwokozi) na 'those' (ubwokozi) kuri bya kure. Ubwishywa bukaze kuri abanyarwanda ni ukubera dutanga gutandukanya 'uwundi' na 'uwundi' mu Icyongereza, kandi kenshi dusaba 'this' kuri byose twebwe, naho ari kure. Nanone bashaka 'these' (aha) na 'this' (aha) kubera ubushishozwa.
rule: Dusaba 'this' kuri ibintu cyangwa abantu bo mu kuri twe (ubwokozi). Dusaba 'these' kuri ibintu cyangwa abantu bo mu kuri twe (ubwokozi). Dusaba 'that' kuri ibintu cyangwa abantu bo kure (ubwokozi). Dusaba 'those' kuri ibintu cyangwa abantu bo kure (ubwokozi). Nanone dusabwa mu kwigisha: 'This is my friend' (iyo ari yo) na 'That is my house' (iyo turondera kure).

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, 'uwo' na 'abo' ni ibintu bitandukanye, ariko kenshi abanyarwanda basaba 'this' kuri ubwokozi kubera ubushakashatsi, cyangwa bashaka ubushishozwa bw' 'these' /ðiːz/ na 'this' /ðɪs/. Remera ko 'this' ni ubwokozi na 'these' ni ubwokozi.

title: Can (ubushobozi na ububasha)
bridge: Mu gaciri, dutegura 'guta' kugena ubushobozi ('nashobora kugina') na ububasha ('ese nashobora kuhaguruka?'). Mu Icyongereza, 'can' nako zifite ibiri. Ikintu cyiza cyane ni uko 'can' ntikizohinduka mu ndimi z'umuntu wundi (he can, she can) kandi ntabwo higeze hitemo 'to' nyuma yacyo (I can swim, si 'I can to swim'). Uretse ho, mu byibazo n'ubwenge, ntidutuma 'do/does' ariko turahindura ubwoko (Can you swim?) cyangwa dutanga 'not' (I cannot / can't). Ni umubare w'imvugo, bityo byose byararohwejwe n'imvugo y'ubwoko bw'ishusho bitagira 'to'.
rule: 'Can' biterwa kuri: 1) ubushobozi (I can play the piano), 2) ububasha (Can I go to the bathroom?), 3) ubushakashatsi (It can rain tomorrow). Ntibihinduka kuri buri wese. Mu kuri: I/you/he/she/it/we/they can + imvugo y'ubwoko bw'ishusho. Mu kwenga: cannot (can't) + imvugo y'ubwoko bw'ishusho. Mu byibazo: Can + umuntu + imvugo y'ubwoko bw'ishusho? Mu maganuro y'ubushishije: Yes, I can / No, I can't.

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, tuganira 'nashobora kugina' bitagira aho hitamo. Mu Icyongereza, 'can' birarohwejwe n'imvugo y'ubwoko bw'ishusho BITAGIRA 'to'. Kuganira 'can to' ni ibyaha byinshi kuri buri muntu kandi bikomeye kuri bo bishaka kugira ubwoko bw'imvugo (want to, need to).

examples.original: Can they come? Yes, they can.

title: Ibibazo by’ubusa ‘wh-’ (what, where, who, when)
bridge: Mu gaciri, dusaba ibibazo hamwe n’amagambo nk’ ‘iki’, ‘ahō’, ‘uvu’, ‘ryari’. Mu Icyongereza ni nk’ibyo: 'what' (iki), 'where' (ahō), 'who' (uvu), 'when' (ryari). Uburyo bwo kugira ibibazo ni: Ijambo ry’ubusa wh- + umubare w’ubusa (cyangwa ijambo ‘to be’) + inyandikorwa + ijambo ry’ubusa? Uyu mubare: 'Where do you live?' (Uraha uri he?). Ubwoba bw’abanyarwanda ni kugamburukira ‘do/does’ mu gihe k’ubusa, kandi batagira uburyo bw’ibibazo ndagije (nk’ubwo muri ‘Can you tell me where the station is?’ – ni byo, si ‘where is the station’ mu by’ndagije).
rule: Ibibazo by’ubusa wh- birangwa na uyu mubare: 1) Hamwe n’ijambo ‘to be’: Ijambo ry’ubusa wh- + am/is/are + inyandikorwa? (Where is the bank?). 2) Hamwe n’ ‘can’: Ijambo ry’ubusa wh- + can + inyandikorwa + ijambo ry’ubusa? (What can you do?). 3) Hamwe n’ubusa bw’inyandikorwa (ijambo ry’ubusa): Ijambo ry’ubusa wh- + do/does + inyandikorwa + ijambo ry’ubusa? (What do you eat?). 4) Mu bibazo by’ndagije (nyuma y’ ‘Can you tell me...’, 'Do you know...'), uburyo ni inyandikorwa + ijambo ry’ubusa (si kugamburukira): 'Can you tell me where the station is?' (si 'where is the station').

common_error.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
common_error.correct: Can you tell me where the station is?
common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, mu bibazo by’ndagije tubura uburyo bw’ibibazo ndagije: ‘¿Puedes decirme dónde está la estación?’. Mu Icyongereza, mu bibazo by’ndagije, uburyo ni inyandikorwa + ijambo ry’ubusa, si kugamburukira. Ni ubwoba bw’abanyarwanda bukomeye.

title: Hari / Hariho
bridge: Mu gishimikiri, kandi tubwira 'hari' tukoresha ijambo rimwe gusa: 'hari'. Mu Icyongereza, hari uburyo bubiri: 'there is' (ubwoko bw'umwe) na 'there are' (ubwoko bw'inganji). Ikintu gikorwa n'ijambo rifuzwa ryerekana. Nk'uburanga: 'There is a book on the table' (Hari igitabo ku meza), 'There are two books on the table' (Hari ibitabo bibiri ku meza). Nanone bikoreshwa mu ibibazo: 'Is there a bank near here?' na 'Are there any restaurants?'. Ubwoba bw'abanyarwanda ni guhangana 'there is/are' na 'have' (bavuga 'The house has a garden' aho kandi 'There is a garden in the house').
rule: Tukoresha 'There is' ku byo tubwira mu bwoko bw'umwe n'ibyifuzo (There is some water). Tukoresha 'There are' ku byo tubwira mu bwoko bw'inganji (There are three chairs). Mu ibibazo: Is there...? / Are there...? Mu ibyaha: There isn't / There aren't. Nanone bikoreshwa na 'any' mu ibibazo n'ibyaha: 'Is there any milk?' (Hari amata?) na 'There isn't any milk' (Nta mata yahari).

concept_examples.text: There is a cat in the garden.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə kæt ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːdən/

concept_examples.text: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr tuː tʃeəz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/

concept_examples.text: Is there a bank near here?
There aren't any students in the class.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn ðə klɑːs/

common_error.wrong: In my house have a garden.
common_error.correct: There is a garden in my house.
common_error.explanation: Mu gishimikiri, tubwira 'Inzu yanjye ifite urugi' tukoresha 'tener', ariko mu Icyongereza, kugena ubwoba, tukoresha 'there is/are', si 'have'. Ni ubwisha bw'ubugerezano buvuye n'ubugereranyije. Ubuvuga 'My house has a garden' (tener) nk'uburyo bwo kugena, ariko 'there is' ni ikoreshwa cyane kugena ubwoba mu kindi.

examples.original: There is a phone on the desk.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə fəʊn ɒn ðə desk/

examples.original: There are three cars in the street.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr θriː kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/

levels.label: Questions with Is there / Are there
levels.translation: Ibibazo na Is there / Are there

examples.original: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈeni eɡz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/
examples.note: Ibibazo na 'any' ku byo tubwira mu bwoko bw'inganji.

examples.original: There isn't any sugar in the cupboard.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ˈɪzənt ˈeni ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈkʌbəd/
examples.note: Ibihawe na 'any' ku byo tubwira bitifuzwa.
